works.detail: 第一作者 · 目标 TPAMI
works.title: Appearance Variations in Person Re-Identification: A Survey
works.body: 以短期扰动、长期外观变化与复合变化重新组织 ReID 文献，从外观鲁棒性与外观泛化两个角度审视方法和评测。当前仍在推进写作、模型微调与实验。

projects.title: A4R 引导式手机 AI 助手
projects.body: 参与设计“先澄清、再执行、再验证”的交互流程，并构建 150 余条真实交互样本，覆盖 6 个领域和 16 款应用。在中国联通真实任务上，系统完成率达到 64.68%，有效引导率达到 72.33%。

projects.title: 模块化机器人系统
projects.body: 负责模块协同、总线仲裁、热插拔识别与总线合并等底层控制逻辑，使模块增删或重排后能够重新发现拓扑并恢复通信。系统通信成功率达到 98.5%，通信效率较原方案提升约 40%。

projects.title: SmartPhone Battery: The Moment of Depletion
projects.body: 团队把屏幕、计算和通信负载纳入统一物理模型，并用 ECM-EKF 与 PINN 两条路径交叉验证。在 8 类数据、超过 12 万个时间步上，SOC RMSE 为 1.24%，整体 TTE MAPE 为 8.7%。

projects.title: 小米四足机器人智能物流配送系统
projects.body: 参与系统方案、算法调试、任务流程优化和现场测试，重点处理配送阶段之间的状态切换与动作时序，降低识别失败或路径偏移对后续任务的连锁影响。

works.title: Reliability-Aware 3D Geometric Injection for Universal Person Re-identification
works.body: UniGeo introduces monocular 3D body geometry as complementary evidence for person re-identification. A reliability-aware gate suppresses unreliable geometric estimates. Comparisons, ablations, and perturbation tests span nine benchmarks.

figure.alt: UniGeo framework: visual and 3D structural streams combined through reliability-aware gating.

works.title: PEARL: Auditable Repair for Scientific Reasoning Graph Extraction
works.body: PEARL combines schema-constrained graph materialization with judge-feedback semantic repair, turning model-generated scientific reasoning graphs into auditable artifacts. The paper was accepted to the WAICA 2026 Multi-Modal Agents for Science Workshop.

figure.alt: PEARL framework: graph extraction, structure repair, semantic repair, re-evaluation, and the strict closure gate.
figure.caption: PEARL framework · Figure 1
figure.open_label: View the full-size PEARL framework figure

works.title: Appearance Variations in Person Re-Identification: A Survey
works.body: A survey organized around short-term perturbations, long-term appearance changes, and compound variations. The work examines methods and evaluation through appearance robustness and generalization; writing and experiments are ongoing.

projects.title: A4R: Guided Smartphone AI Assistant
projects.body: I co-designed a clarify-execute-verify interaction workflow and built more than 150 real interactions across six domains and 16 applications. On China Unicom tasks, the system achieved a 64.68% completion rate and a 72.33% effective-guidance rate.

projects.title: Modular Robot System
projects.body: I was responsible for module coordination, bus arbitration, hot-plug discovery, and bus merging, allowing the controller to rediscover topology and restore communication after modules were added or reordered. The system reached a 98.5% communication success rate and improved communication efficiency by about 40% over the original design.

projects.title: SmartPhone Battery: The Moment of Depletion
projects.body: Our team modeled screen, computation, and communication loads in a shared physical framework, then cross-checked an ECM-EKF solver with a physics-informed neural network. Across eight data sources and more than 120,000 time steps, SOC RMSE was 1.24% and overall TTE MAPE was 8.7%.

projects.title: Xiaomi Quadruped Logistics System
projects.body: I contributed to system design, algorithm debugging, workflow optimization, and on-site testing. My work focused on state transitions and action timing between delivery stages, reducing the downstream effects of recognition failures and path deviations.
